args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 18%) since its deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Diagnosed the issue**
   - `checkout-api` was running **v2.3.1** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of **18%**.
   - Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production version was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed with status `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified recovery** — checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to **0.2%**.

Note: the unhealthy v2.3.1 release remains in the deployment history, so the on-call engineer can investigate the root cause before any re-deploy attempt.
